sourceOfTruth: Current HACHARA UI/UX lesson registry: 96 physical lesson files, comprising 95 curriculum lesson units plus 1 reference/template (lesson.html).
historicalContext: Earlier 117-lesson and 63-file references are historical reconciliation states and are not the current UI/UX source-of-truth count.
rules: Every lesson keeps its stable lesson ID and original sequence number.
Bundle and module grouping is organizational metadata and must not rewrite lesson content.
A lesson may belong to one primary module and may have secondary skill mappings.
Source gaps must remain explicitly marked as source-gap until authoritative content is recovered.
No invented lesson text, examples, exercises, answers, or source references.
Existing completion state remains preserved while capability validation is tracked separately.
Mapping changes must be additive and auditable.
Any ambiguous mapping is flagged for review rather than silently resolved.
safeBenchmark: Protected; mapping metadata must not alter the locked lesson source.
